title: PROSPECTIVE replication: does the three-guild rate replicate on unseen seeds?

identity.note: The probe always ran from the current checkout. A historical arm spec applied here is a settings replay, not a reproduction of its original figure.

preregistration.hypothesis: The three-guild rate measured on the 41001-41018 panel (~5/18) is a property of the engine, not of that panel. Closing the decomposer capture leak removed the decomposer surplus that was propping up coexistence, so three-guild worlds should be RARE on unseen seeds too, and consumer presence should remain common.
preregistration.prediction: PROSPECTIVE, stated before inspection: consumers > 0 on at least 12/18, AND all three guilds non-zero on at most 8/18. The first clause asserts consumer viability replicates; the second asserts the BALANCE shortfall replicates rather than being an artefact of the old panel.
preregistration.falsification: FALSIFIED if consumers > 0 on fewer than 12/18 (consumer viability does not replicate), OR all three guilds are non-zero on 9 or more of 18 (the shortfall was panel-specific and balance is reachable once the accounting is honest).
preregistration.notPredicted: Exact counts are not predicted. Consumer-yield on the old panel was 14/18 consumers and 5/18 three-guild; this arm asks whether those RATES hold, not whether they match exactly.
confoundsControlled: Same arm settings as consumer-yield (producerCaptureScale 0.35, basalFoodPerCell 0.25, disease 0.15, sat 0.4, nfloor 0)
Same 6000-tick horizon as the consumer-yield arm it replicates
Identical engine (ts-evo-poc/0.6.0); the ONLY difference from consumer-yield is the seed panel
conservation enforced per seed at 0.5%; a seed above it fails the run rather than reporting

criteria.statement: consumers > 0 at tick 6000 on at least 12/18 seeds

all three guilds non-zero on AT MOST 8/18 seeds — encoded as its exact complement, at least 10/18 seeds where allGuildsNonZero == 0. Counting the complement is what makes the boundary machine-checkable: 8 versus 9 is the supported/falsified edge.
